notes.title: Update 1.4.9 is out!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12076110/ae6ee9e8af1d88836c0371cc794332fcf61cbdf2.png[/img]

This is a large patch that should fix all reported issues, including rare out-of-memory crashes. It also moves the game to a new resource management system that paves the road for future improvements (like the ones we brought to Cinders earlier this year).

If you experience any issues, please let us know in the comments or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/317280/discussions/0/385428943465777915/]dedicated community thread[/url]. :)


NOTE: Your old saves may display question marks instead of their normal thumbnails in the load menu. Don't worry -- they should work just fine and any further saves will behave normally.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
We just uploaded a new version that should fix all the outstanding issues and typos.

If you still encounter anything weird after the update, make sure to post it in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/317280/discussions/0/385428943465777915/]bug reporting thread[/url]. Just remember to paste the contents of the error message you got and some info on when exactly it happened (like the last line said).

Cheers, and thanks for your help with bug hunting! :)
-MoaCube
